subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the 14-action batch be accepted after one consolidated privileged-workflow review, or should the token, release, and Codex action updates be split for isolated validation and rollback?
rationale: The diff is mechanically correct, but it replaces executable third-party code in jobs holding sensitive credentials and permissions that PR CI does not fully exercise; repository automation cannot choose the acceptable validation and rollback boundary.

options.title: Review and merge the batch
options.body: Verify every privileged action SHA and release note, wait for exact-head gates, and explicitly accept event-specific workflow risk as one coordinated maintenance update.

options.title: Split privileged action families
options.body: Separate app-token, Docker release, and Codex action pins into independently validated PRs for clearer smoke testing and rollback.

recommendation.title: Review and merge the batch
recommendation.body: Verify every privileged action SHA and release note, wait for exact-head gates, and explicitly accept event-specific workflow risk as one coordinated maintenance update.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows the broadest ownership across GitHub Actions modernization, Codex-agent workflows, and adjacent release automation.
